column2: Open Figma bugs per catalog section, joined on the route column of
status.<section>.tsv. Bug data: 603 open reports (status new/needs_info,
Matched 348/603. A bug route is matched to the MOST SPECIFIC section
route that prefixes it, so /play/scratchers lands on scratchers, not /play.
UNMATCHED — NO catalog section claims these routes, so these bugs land on a
surface the catalog cannot describe. Each one is a coverage gap:
TIES — several sections claim the same route at equal specificity; attributed
to the section with the most frames:
ROOT AMBIGUITY — 4 sections list "/" as their route
(home, onboarding, trade, wallet), so the 162 bugs reported on "/" cannot be
honestly attributed to one of them. Fix the route column, do not break the tie.
